evaluations.evidence: using content identification or fingerprinting
evaluations.rationale: Distinct music discovery method; not duplicating profile, similar user, video similarity, or metadata stories.

evaluations.evidence: based on my profile
evaluations.rationale: Profile-based search is distinct from similar-user search and recommendation stories.

evaluations.evidence: based on other users similar to myself
evaluations.rationale: Search based on similar users is distinct in goal from receiving content recommendations from similar profiles.

evaluations.evidence: similar to a given music video based on content similarity
evaluations.rationale: Query-by-music-video similarity is distinct from music fingerprinting and metadata-based discovery.

evaluations.evidence: exploiting enriched metadata and image tags
evaluations.rationale: Metadata and image tag discovery path is distinct from other music search mechanisms.

evaluations.evidence: upload tagged videos and have tags available
evaluations.rationale: Upload and tag availability requirement is not duplicated elsewhere.

evaluations.evidence: view thumbnail sequences of video segments
evaluations.rationale: Thumbnail sequence viewing is a unique requirement.

evaluations.evidence: similar video items and segments
evaluations.rationale: General video similarity information is distinct from perceptual similarity specified in ZO-009.

evaluations.evidence: perceptually similar video items and segments
evaluations.rationale: Perceptual similarity is a meaningful narrowing of similarity type, not the same requirement as general similarity in ZO-008.

evaluations.evidence: receive content recommendations from similar profiles
evaluations.rationale: Recommendation from similar profiles is distinct from searching music by one's own profile or similar users.

evaluations.evidence: most relevant news events in my area
evaluations.rationale: Location-based news recommendation is not repeated elsewhere.

evaluations.evidence: identify persons in videos
evaluations.rationale: Person identification is a distinct recognition target from products, logos, and brands.

evaluations.evidence: identify products in videos
evaluations.rationale: Product identification is distinct from other entity identification stories.

evaluations.evidence: identify broadcaster logos in videos
evaluations.rationale: Broadcaster logo identification is a distinct recognition target from persons, products, and general brands.

evaluations.evidence: identify brands in videos
evaluations.rationale: Brand identification is distinct enough from broadcaster logo identification; no substantial containment.

evaluations.evidence: take a picture or upload an image
evaluations.rationale: Image-query recommendation is unique among content discovery stories.

evaluations.evidence: access content using a geographical map
evaluations.rationale: Geographic map-based content access is not repeated elsewhere.

evaluations.evidence: search content items using automatic speech recognition
evaluations.rationale: Speech recognition search is unique.

evaluations.evidence: see, validate and edit segmentation
evaluations.rationale: Segmentation administration is distinct from annotation and topic extraction.

evaluations.evidence: annotate news video segments and extract a topic
evaluations.rationale: Annotation and topic extraction is distinct from segmentation validation.

evaluations.evidence: filter and rank videos based on A/V quality
evaluations.rationale: A/V quality filtering/ranking is unique.

evaluations.evidence: whether audio material has been edited
evaluations.rationale: Audio editing assessment is distinct from quality ranking and other prefiltering.

evaluations.evidence: prefilter nudity content
evaluations.rationale: Nudity prefiltering is a distinct moderation rule.

evaluations.evidence: low-level asset information
evaluations.rationale: Low-level asset search is a distinct business rule from high-level metadata search.

evaluations.evidence: automatically validated the ingested contents for copyright infringement
evaluations.rationale: Copyright infringement validation is unique.

evaluations.evidence: high-level asset information such as metadata and tags
evaluations.rationale: High-level metadata/tag search is meaningfully different from low-level asset search.

evaluations.evidence: assess how interesting or appealing or complex a picture is
evaluations.rationale: Interestingness/appeal assessment is distinct from scientist prompting detection.

evaluations.evidence: detect when a scientist should be prompted
evaluations.rationale: Prompting scientist decision is distinct from picture assessment.

evaluations.evidence: identify volunteer types
evaluations.rationale: Volunteer type identification is unique.

evaluations.evidence: preclassify the Galaxy Zoo images using simple low-level image features
evaluations.rationale: Galaxy Zoo-specific preclassification differs in domain from other preclassification stories.

evaluations.evidence: Snapshot Serengeti images with no classifiable animals
evaluations.rationale: Empty-animal detection in Snapshot Serengeti is contextually distinct from empty-plankton detection.

evaluations.evidence: automatic image series detection for timestamping malfunction
evaluations.rationale: Image series detection for timestamping is unique to this context.

evaluations.evidence: animal species preclassification in Snapshot Serengeti
evaluations.rationale: Species preclassification in Snapshot Serengeti is domain-specific and distinct from Plankton species classification.

evaluations.evidence: animal attribute preclassification in Snapshot Serengeti
evaluations.rationale: Attribute preclassification is distinct from species detection and other Snapshot Serengeti tasks.

evaluations.evidence: animal number detection in Snapshot Serengeti
evaluations.rationale: Animal count detection is distinct from species, attribute, and empty-image detection.

evaluations.evidence: segmentation or localization of plankton
evaluations.rationale: Plankton segmentation/localization is unique.

evaluations.evidence: Plankton Portal images with no classifiable plankton
evaluations.rationale: Empty-plankton detection is contextually distinct from empty-animal detection in Snapshot Serengeti.

evaluations.evidence: detection of plankton size or orientation
evaluations.rationale: Plankton size/orientation detection is distinct from species classification and segmentation.

evaluations.evidence: preclassification of plankton species
evaluations.rationale: Plankton species classification is domain-specific and distinct from Snapshot Serengeti species classification.

evaluations.evidence: worm motion analysis to reduce video duration
evaluations.rationale: Worm motion analysis is unique.

evaluations.evidence: detect the time where the worm lays an egg
evaluations.rationale: Worm egg-laying detection is distinct from general motion analysis.

evaluations.evidence: areas of flooding, damage, temporary shelters, blocked roads
evaluations.rationale: Satellite image feature detection is unique.

evaluations.evidence: probability/weight of a volunteer's classification based on experience
evaluations.rationale: Volunteer classification weighting is distinct from volunteer type identification.

evaluations.evidence: prefiltering of images to remove artefacts
evaluations.rationale: Artefact removal is distinct from moving object detection and other image analysis stories.

evaluations.evidence: detect moving and transient objects
evaluations.rationale: Moving/transient object detection is distinct from artefact prefiltering.

evaluations.evidence: remove background noise and distracting sounds
evaluations.rationale: Audio noise removal is unique.

evaluations.evidence: group whale calls that are similar
evaluations.rationale: Whale-call grouping is domain-specific and distinct from grouping subjects by similarity.

evaluations.evidence: identify the number of whales heard
evaluations.rationale: Whale count detection is unique.

evaluations.evidence: know when I should interrupt a volunteer
evaluations.rationale: Interruption timing is distinct from education timing.

evaluations.evidence: whether I should interrupt a volunteer with text, an image, or a video
evaluations.rationale: Interruption modality is distinct from education modality.

evaluations.evidence: know when I should educate a volunteer
evaluations.rationale: Education timing is distinct from interruption timing.

evaluations.evidence: whether I should educate a volunteer with text, an image, or a video
evaluations.rationale: Education modality is distinct from interruption modality.

evaluations.evidence: which piece of education I should give
evaluations.rationale: Selection of educational content is distinct from timing and modality stories.

evaluations.evidence: volunteer has made an interesting comment
evaluations.rationale: Detecting interesting volunteer comments is distinct from deciding Zoonibot comments.

evaluations.evidence: when Zoonibot should comment on a subject
evaluations.rationale: Zoonibot commenting decision is distinct from giving explanations or detecting volunteer comments.

evaluations.evidence: when Zoonibot should give an explanation
evaluations.rationale: Explanation timing is a different bot action from commenting.

evaluations.evidence: what Zoonibot should say
evaluations.rationale: Message content selection is distinct from when-to-comment or when-to-explain decisions.

evaluations.evidence: group subjects by similarity
evaluations.rationale: Grouping subjects by similarity is distinct from domain-specific whale-call grouping.

evaluations.evidence: recommend different projects to volunteers based on previous experiences
evaluations.rationale: Project recommendation for volunteers is distinct from content recommendations from similar profiles.

evaluations.evidence: see a summary of articles, so that I reuse them
evaluations.rationale: Article summary reuse is unique.
